mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rates above 3.5% triggers labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 3.5%, or the rate does not rise sufficiently.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high demand (GDPC1 > 19,000 billion chained 2017 USD) and monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) create a favorable environment for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or returns are negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL index signals rising inflation expectations, compressing real equity returns and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL decreases instead of increasing.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary accommodation, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not active, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the INDPRO supply index below 110 signals over-supplied markets, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses below 110, or the index does not decline sufficiently.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor demand (PAYEMS > 152,000) combined with monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) creates a favorable equity environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or returns are negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, high demand (RSAFS > 500,000) and low labor costs (UNRATE < 3.0%) signal improved economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: in post-shock recovery regime and RSAFS > 500000 and UNRATE < 3.0%
failure_condition: The regime is not active, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or returns are negative despite the signal.
